words.definition: vt. 支撑；增强，提振；n. 长枕，垫木

examples.en: The central bank cut interest rates to bolster the slowing economy.
examples.zh: 央行降息以提振放缓的经济。

examples.en: His argument was bolstered by a wealth of survey data.
examples.zh: 大量调查数据为他的论点提供了支撑。

words.usage: 考研高频及物动词，常接 confidence、economy、argument 等抽象宾语；bolster up 亦可表「支撑」。名词义为「长枕垫」，阅读中较少见。派生：bolstering n. 支持
collocations: bolster confidence 增强信心
bolster the economy 提振经济
bolster sb's argument 支持某人的论点
words.mnemonic: bol（圆枕）+ster→圆枕托底→支撑、增强

words.definition: vt. 屠杀，宰杀；n. 惨败

examples.en: Tens of thousands of civilians were slaughtered during the war.
examples.zh: 战争期间数万平民惨遭屠杀。

examples.en: The team suffered a 5-0 slaughter in the final.
examples.zh: 决赛中该队以零比五惨败。

words.usage: 动词兼名词，既指大规模屠杀，也指宰杀牲畜；口语中可表比赛「惨败」。常见被动 be slaughtered。派生：slaughterhouse n. 屠宰场
collocations: slaughter cattle 屠宰牛群
suffer a slaughter 遭遇惨败
the slaughter of innocent civilians 屠杀无辜平民
words.mnemonic: s+laughter（笑声）→笑声戛然而止→屠杀

words.definition: vt. 抑制；阻止；使拘束

examples.en: High interest rates may inhibit companies from investing in new equipment.
examples.zh: 高利率可能抑制企业对新设备的投资。

examples.en: Fear of failure can inhibit creativity in the classroom.
examples.zh: 对失败的恐惧会抑制课堂上的创造力。

words.usage: 常用于 inhibit sb/sth from doing sth（阻止…做…）；科技与医学文中表「抑制（反应、生长）」。派生：inhibition n. 抑制；inhibitor n. 抑制剂
collocations: inhibit economic growth 抑制经济增长
inhibit sb from doing 阻止某人做某事
an enzyme inhibitor 酶抑制剂
words.mnemonic: in（内）+hibit（持，握）→按在心里→抑制

words.definition: vi. 暴跌；vt. 使陷入；n. 猛跌

examples.en: Share prices plunged by nearly 20 percent in a single day.
examples.zh: 股价单日暴跌近百分之二十。

examples.en: The city was plunged into darkness after the storm.
examples.zh: 风暴过后全城陷入黑暗。

words.usage: 数字骤降高频：plunge by/to（跌至）；be plunged into（陷入某种状态）；take the plunge 意为「果断一试」。派生：plunging adj. 骤降的
collocations: plunge into poverty 陷入贫困
take the plunge 大胆尝试
profits plunge by 30% 利润暴跌三成
words.mnemonic: pl（扑通）+unge→扑通跳进水里→骤跌

words.definition: vt. 吸入；vi. 吸气

examples.en: Workers inhaled toxic fumes before the ventilation was fixed.
examples.zh: 通风修好之前，工人们吸入了有毒气体。

examples.en: She inhaled deeply before opening the letter.
examples.zh: 拆信之前她深吸了一口气。

words.usage: 与 exhale（呼出）为一对反义构词；常见 inhale deeply（深吸气）。医学、环保阅读高频。派生：inhalation n. 吸入；inhaler n. 吸入器
collocations: inhale deeply 深吸一口气
inhale toxic fumes 吸入有毒烟雾
inhale and exhale 一吸一呼
words.mnemonic: in（向内）+hale（呼吸）→把气吸进来

words.definition: vt. 砰地关上；猛击；n. 抨击

examples.en: He slammed the door and stormed out of the meeting room.
examples.zh: 他砰地摔上门，冲出了会议室。

examples.en: The new policy was slammed by opposition parties.
examples.zh: 新政策遭到反对党的猛烈抨击。

words.usage: 本义拟声「砰地关上」；新闻英语常用被动 be slammed by critics 表「遭炮轰」；slam into 表猛撞。名词另指猛击、抨击。
collocations: slam the door 摔门
slam on the brakes 猛踩刹车
be slammed by critics 遭评论界抨击
words.mnemonic: 拟声词：关门「砰」一声→猛关、猛击

words.definition: n. 复数；adj. 复数的；多元的

examples.en: In this sentence the plural form of the noun is required.
examples.zh: 在这个句子里，名词需要用复数形式。

examples.en: Modern democracies thrive in plural societies with diverse cultures.
examples.zh: 现代民主在文化多元的社会中蓬勃发展。

words.usage: 语法术语：in the plural（用复数形式），反义 singular；引申义「多元的」见于社科文章：a plural society。派生：pluralism n. 多元主义
collocations: the plural form 复数形式
in the plural 用复数形式
a plural society 多元社会
words.mnemonic: plur（多）+al→多于一个→复数、多元

words.definition: adj. 中世纪的；陈旧的

examples.en: The castle dates back to medieval times and attracts many tourists.
examples.zh: 这座城堡可追溯至中世纪，吸引众多游客。

examples.en: Critics condemned the prison conditions as medieval.
examples.zh: 批评者斥责监狱条件如同中世纪般落后。

words.usage: 专指欧洲约公元 500 至 1500 年间；考研常见 medieval Europe/architecture；口语引申「极其落后陈旧」，带贬义。派生：medievalism n. 中世纪风尚
collocations: medieval times 中世纪
medieval Europe 中世纪欧洲
medieval architecture 中世纪建筑
words.mnemonic: medi（中间）+eval（时代）→居中的年代→中世纪

words.definition: vt. 撇去；略读；vi. 掠过

examples.en: Skim the text quickly to get a general idea before answering.
examples.zh: 答题前先快速略读全文，把握大意。

examples.en: The seaplane skimmed over the calm water at low speed.
examples.zh: 水上飞机低速掠过平静的水面。

words.usage: 阅读技巧词：skim through/over（略读，抓大意），与 scan（查读，找细节）相对；本义撇去浮沫、掠过表面；skim milk 指脱脂牛奶。
collocations: skim through a report 略读报告
skim the cream off 撇去奶油
skim milk 脱脂牛奶
words.mnemonic: ski（滑雪）+m→如滑雪般掠过→略读

words.definition: adj. 轻微的；纤细的；vt. 怠慢

examples.en: There has been a slight improvement in the patient's condition.
examples.zh: 病人的病情略有好转。

examples.en: She felt slighted when her proposal was ignored at the meeting.
examples.zh: 会上她的提议被无视，她感到受了怠慢。

words.usage: 高频修饰变化量：a slight increase/change；否定搭配 not in the slightest（一点也不）；动词义「怠慢」见于 feel slighted。派生：slightly adv. 稍微
collocations: a slight increase 轻微增长
not in the slightest 一点也不
a slight figure 纤瘦的身材
words.mnemonic: s+light（轻）→比轻更轻一分→轻微的

words.definition: vt. 居住于；栖息于

examples.en: Rare birds inhabit the wetlands in the southern part of the island.
examples.zh: 珍稀鸟类栖息在该岛南部的湿地。

examples.en: The valley has been inhabited since prehistoric times.
examples.zh: 自史前时代起就有人居住在这条山谷。

words.usage: 正式用语，主语多为人群或物种；被动 be inhabited by 很常见；不用进行时。派生：inhabitant n. 居民；inhabitable adj. 宜居的
collocations: inhabit an island 居住在岛上
a densely inhabited district 人口稠密区
be inhabited by 有…居住
words.mnemonic: in（在其中）+habit（拥有）→拥有栖身之所

words.definition: vt. 放牧；擦伤；vi. 吃草

examples.en: Sheep were grazing peacefully on the hillside.
examples.zh: 羊群在山坡上安静地吃草。

examples.en: The bullet grazed his shoulder, leaving only a shallow wound.
examples.zh: 子弹擦过他的肩膀，只留下浅浅的伤口。

words.usage: 本义牲畜吃草、放牧；引申「擦破皮」，程度比 cut 轻；名词 a graze 指擦伤处。派生：grazing n. 放牧；牧草
collocations: graze on the hillside 在山坡吃草
graze one's knee 擦破膝盖
grazing land 牧场
words.mnemonic: grass（草）藏个 graze→吃草；擦破如草划

words.definition: adj. 苗条的；微小的；vi. 减肥

examples.en: There is only a slim chance that the deal will be approved.
examples.zh: 这笔交易获批的希望十分渺茫。

examples.en: The company slimmed down its workforce to cut costs.
examples.zh: 公司精简员工队伍以削减成本。

words.usage: 高频引申：a slim chance/margin（机会渺茫/微弱优势）；slim down（瘦身；精简机构）。派生：slimming n. 减肥；瘦身
collocations: a slim chance 渺茫的机会
slim down 瘦身；精简
a slim majority 微弱多数
words.mnemonic: s+limb（肢体）→无臂无腿只剩细长→苗条

words.definition: adj. 巨大的；极好的

examples.en: The project requires a tremendous amount of time and money.
examples.zh: 该项目需要耗费大量的时间和金钱。

examples.en: She made tremendous progress in spoken English within a year.
examples.zh: 一年之内她的英语口语进步巨大。

words.usage: 修饰数量、压力、变化、影响等抽象名词：tremendous pressure/progress；口语兼表「了不起的」。派生：tremendously adv. 极大地
collocations: tremendous pressure 巨大压力
tremendous progress 巨大进步
a tremendous success 巨大成功
words.mnemonic: trem（颤抖）+endous→大得令人发抖→巨大

words.definition: vt. 堵塞；插上电源；n. 插头

examples.en: Plug the charger into the socket before you leave.
examples.zh: 离开前把充电器插进插座。

examples.en: New funding helped plug the gap in the city's budget.
examples.zh: 新拨款帮助填补了该市预算的缺口。

words.usage: 常用短语：plug in（接通电源）、plug the gap（填补缺口）、plug away at（坚持不懈）。名词另指媒体上的「宣传」：give sth a plug。
collocations: plug in the device 插上设备
plug the gap 填补缺口
plug away at 坚持做
words.mnemonic: p+lug（柄）→带柄的堵头→插头、堵塞

words.definition: adj. 严重的；严肃的；n. 坟墓

examples.en: Climate change poses a grave threat to coastal cities.
examples.zh: 气候变化给沿海城市带来严重威胁。

examples.en: His face was grave as he read the medical report.
examples.zh: 读医疗报告时，他神情严肃。

words.usage: 形容词高频修饰 threat/concern 等名词；名词习语 from the cradle to the grave 意为「一生」。派生：gravely adv. 严重地；gravity n. 重力
collocations: grave consequences 严重后果
a grave mistake 严重错误
from the cradle to the grave 从生到死
words.mnemonic: 坟墓令人心情沉重→严重的、肃穆的

words.definition: adv. 在楼上；往楼上；adj. 楼上的

examples.en: The bedrooms are upstairs, while the kitchen is downstairs.
examples.zh: 卧室在楼上，厨房在楼下。

examples.en: An upstairs window was left open all night.
examples.zh: 楼上的一扇窗整夜开着。

words.usage: 地点副词，前面不加介词：go upstairs（不说 go to upstairs）；亦可作定语形容词 an upstairs room。反义 downstairs，对记更牢。
collocations: go upstairs 上楼
an upstairs bedroom 楼上的卧室
upstairs and downstairs 楼上楼下
words.mnemonic: up（上）+stair（梯）+s→顺梯而上→楼上

words.definition: prep. 除…之外（还）；adv. 而且

examples.en: Besides English, she is fluent in German and Japanese.
examples.zh: 除英语外，她的德语和日语也很流利。

examples.en: I don't want to drive tonight; besides, the car needs fuel.
examples.zh: 今晚我不想开车；再说，车也该加油了。

words.usage: 介词义「包括在内」，与 except（排除在外）构成考点对比；句首副词义表补充论证「再说」。勿与 beside（在旁边）混淆。
collocations: besides this 除此之外
besides English 除英语外（还有）
and besides 再说
words.mnemonic: beside（旁）+s→身旁还有一份→除…还有

words.definition: vt. 模拟；假装

examples.en: The software can simulate real flight conditions for trainee pilots.
examples.zh: 该软件能为受训飞行员模拟真实飞行条件。

examples.en: He simulated interest in the plan to please his boss.
examples.zh: 为取悦上司，他假装对该计划有兴趣。

words.usage: 科技阅读高频：simulate conditions/an environment；派生：simulation n. 模拟；simulated adj. 仿真的。考研常考与 stimulate（刺激）的形近辨析。
collocations: simulate real conditions 模拟真实环境
a simulated exam 模拟考试
simulate surprise 假装惊讶
words.mnemonic: simul（相同）+ate→做得跟真的一样→模拟

words.definition: vt./vi. 啜饮；n. 一小口

examples.en: She sipped her tea slowly, lost in thought.
examples.zh: 她若有所思地慢慢啜着茶。

examples.en: He took a sip of water before continuing his speech.
examples.zh: 他抿了一口水，接着演讲。

words.usage: 及物直接接饮品：sip tea；短语 take a sip of（抿一口）；与 gulp（大口吞）相对，动作描写高频；名词 a sip 意为「一口」。
collocations: take a sip 抿一口
sip coffee slowly 慢啜咖啡
a sip of soup 一口汤
words.mnemonic: 象声「嘶——」细吸一小口→啜饮
